text: The rain stopped! Everything is shiny, Pip!
Ollie, look up. Look up!
A rainbow! It's so big and so bright!
Where does a rainbow come from?
Let's find out!
Maybe the sky painted it.
With what? Sky paint?
Maybe it fell off a very big butterfly.
Easy! The rainbow is a prize, and I'm getting it!
A prize for what?
For whoever gets to the end first. And that's me!
I'll race you, Gus! Follow me!
Ollie, I have an idea! Ollie? Please stop!
Sorry, Pip. I ran before I listened. What's your idea?
The rain stopped and the sun came out. Maybe they go together.
Too slow! I've got a faster way!
Gus, your faster ways always go wrong.
Not this time! I'll run to the end and grab the rainbow!
Can you grab a rainbow?
Watch me! I'll put it in my hat!
What if we try it the careful way?
Let's watch Gus first. Then we ask Gran Mari.
Hey! Stay still, rainbow!
There it is! It came down all by itself!
Gus, that's a different rainbow.
It's mine now! I caught it!
My rainbow. Nobody else gets to look.
Share?
Uh oh. Where did it go?
Did you lose it, Gus?
No! It's just sleeping. Rainbows sleep a lot.
Rainbows sleep?
It was tiny anyway. Hardly a rainbow at all!
We need help. Let's ask Gran Mari.
Well now, a seagull with a tiny hat and an otter with a big question. What's all this?
Gran Mari, where does a rainbow come from?
Oh, that is a good question, Ollie. Let's find out together.
Never look right at the sun, little one. We look at the wall instead.
Sunlight looks plain. But it is made of every color, all mixed up together.
A rainbow! On the wall!
The water bends the light and spreads the colors apart. Tiny drops of rain work just like this glass.
So the rainbow is hiding in the sunlight?
Well now, what do you think happens next?
It moves if you move the glass!
It needs the sun to shine through!
Try it at home with a grown-up! Fill a clear glass with water. Set it on a sunny windowsill.
Look at the wall nearby. Find the rainbow! Never look right at the sun.
Wait. I have to tell you something.
I said my rainbow was sleeping. That was a fib. I covered it with my hat.
I wanted it all for me, and then it was gone. I'm sorry.
Thanks for telling us the truth, Gus.
Look! It's on my shell too!
Share!
There's enough for everybody! That's the best part!
It sparkles even more, with friends.
Time for my Wonder Pocket! Three things we learned.
One. Sunlight is made of all the colors.
Two. Water bends the light and spreads the colors out.
Three. A rainbow needs sunshine. It fades when it's hidden.
And one kind thing to try today. Share your favorite thing.
Bye, everybody! Next time, I'll share first!
